Procurement Officer  Job at Essence Crop Science Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Essence Crop Science Nigeria Limited, an agrochemical manufacturing company, is recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Procurement Officer 

Job Location: ibeju lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced Procurement Officer with a strong background in factory procurement.
	The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience sourcing and purchasing factory-related materials, equipment, spare parts, and consumables. Candidates without manufacturing or factory procurement experience will not be considered.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Source and procure factory materials, equipment, machinery spare parts, and consumables.
	Identify and negotiate with suppliers to obtain the best quality, pricing, and delivery terms.
	Prepare purchase orders and ensure timely procurement of required items.
	Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and evaluate their performance.
	Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with relevant departments to prevent stock shortages.
	Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies and procedures.
	Prepare procurement reports and maintain accurate purchasing records.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree or HND in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2–5 years of proven experience in factory or manufacturing procurement.
	Must have experience procuring factory items, machinery spare parts, production materials, and industrial consumables.
	Strong negotiation, communication, and supplier management skills.
	Proficient in Microsoft Office and procurement systems.
	Must be willing to relocate to Lekki Free Zone.


Preferred Skills:


	Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
	Strong organizational and analytical skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet procurement deadlines.


Salary
N250,000 - N300,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
